\section{Full simulation results}\label{sec:sims-supp}

This appendix gives every setting of designs S1 and S2 (Section~\ref{sec:sims}). For S1 it lists exact recovery, false
positives, false negatives, Hamming distance, the size of the selected model, empty selections, conditional precision,
recall and wall-clock time; for S2 the same measures except false negatives and Hamming distance, which follow from
the others as $\sz(1-\text{recall})$ and their sum with the false positives. Exact recovery and empty selections are
counts out of the $100$ data sets of a setting; times are medians; the other entries are means over the $100$ data
sets, except conditional precision, which is the mean over the data sets with a non-empty selection and is shown as --
when there are fewer than $20$ of them. Measures are defined in Section~\ref{sec:sims-metrics}.

The appendix then gives the S2 precision under other conventions for empty selections and on paired data sets
(Tables~\ref{tab:supp-s2-prec-conv} and~\ref{tab:supp-s2-prec-paired}), the paired exact-recovery comparison of
SMC-BVS and ASI in S2 (Tables~\ref{tab:supp-s2-paired} and~\ref{tab:supp-s2-paired-bys}), the time per submitted data set of these two methods
(Table~\ref{tab:supp-cost-smc-asi}) and the accuracy of escalated and warned SMC-BVS fits
(Table~\ref{tab:supp-escalation}).

\subsection{Design S2}\label{sec:sims-supp-s2}

Each table puts $n=50$ ($\sz=5$) and $n=100$ ($\sz=10$) side by side. Rows are grouped by support type and $\rho$;
within a group, $\nu$ runs over its ten values. The $81$ BAS fits that failed, all at $n=50$, count as empty
selections.

\begin{figure}[hb]\centering
\includegraphics[width=\textwidth]{figures/fig_s2_pr_supp}
\caption{Design S2: conditional precision against mean recall, by support type and $\rho$, pooled over $n$. Each path
joins the ten signal levels $\nu$ of a method; the points are separate simulated settings. Markers grow with $\nu$
over its three largest values and the ring marks $\nu=6$, as in Figure~\ref{fig:s2-recall-fp}. Points with fewer
than $20$ non-empty selections are omitted, which removes the weakest signals for SMC-BVS and
SuSiE.}\label{fig:supp-s2-pr}
